model.foresight: No future refill, cascade, or engine RNG inspection. Power-up target uncertainty uses a fixed independent footprint sampler.

model.sampling: Production cohorts hold the app retry seed fixed while policy choices vary. Sensitivity cohorts vary both seeds. Wilson intervals are conditional bot-screening summaries, not human win rates.
